title: S11T01 - Inventory git health call sites and current failure modes
description: Find every command and workflow surface that invokes git health checks, sync status, doctor status, branch protection handling, dirty worktree detection, or untracked generated artifact detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Call sites and JSON fields for prime, sync status, sync refresh, doctor, and agent-facing handoff output are mapped.
Known failure examples include protected main with dirty collaboration paths and untracked .boreal/ledgers.
The inventory identifies which surfaces should block work and which should report caveats.
closedReason: Inventory accepted: call sites, failure examples, and blocking-versus-caveat surfaces are documented and verified.
